positions.commentary: Nike has built the best brand in the world with amazing distribution and tear-jerking marketing, and will remain a brand people look up to for at least 30 more years.

thesis: The episode argues that Nike has established itself as the world's premier brand, supported by exceptional distribution and emotionally resonant marketing. The speakers believe this competitive advantage will sustain the company's relevance and performance for at least the next 30 years.
